title: gr.Launch(auth = ) UI not correct in code deployed on huggingface.com URL
body:
### Describe the bug

I implemented the gr.Launch(auth = ) with the following code:

iface.launch(auth=login_auth, auth_message= "Enter your username and password that you received from CIMS.AI. To request a login, please email '<email-scrubbed>'",share=True)

While the login form displays correct on the local browser, when deployed on a huggingface.com URL, the styling is missing and the login button doesn't work.

Please see the attached screen shots.

### Have you searched existing issues?  🔎

- [X] I have searched and found no existing issues

### Reproduction

https://huggingface.co/spaces/reporter/NILI

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
Hi @participant1 . It appears the simple case works per your demo. 

That said, I reproduced it with my use case, which involves this public Space: https://huggingface.co/spaces/cimsai/NILI-Mobile which connects to this private Space: https://huggingface.co/spaces/reporter/NILI-Mobile . When I upgraded the public space to 4.0.2, the login page displayed correctly and login worked. But when I upgraded the private space to 4.0.2, the login page on the public Space broke. I did a factory reboot after each change to the requirements.txt file.

Here's a summary of my findings with using different versions in the Spaces:

Public=3.50.2,Private=3.50.2: Works
Public=3.50.2,Private=4.0.2: Works
Public=4.02.,Private=3.50.2: Works (although after factory reset/space restart, sometimes I have to switch away from the App tab to the Files tab and back for the login screen to load properly. This seems to be an intermittent problem, as I can't always reproduce it)
Public=4.0.2,Private=4.0.2: Broken

Here are console errors in the broken state (Public=4.0.2,Private=4.0.2: Broken):
![image](https://github.com/gradio-app/gradio/assets/140648761/e51b2871-f67c-4afe-8ff0-42a44c10c823)

Here's what the console looks like when the intermittent error occurs (Public=4.02.,Private=3.50.2):
![image](https://github.com/gradio-app/gradio/assets/140648761/f1642eb7-a53d-46e4-bf38-3101ed46f4f8)

 If I switch to Files and back to the App tab:
![image](https://github.com/gradio-app/gradio/assets/140648761/2b7c8ac7-3eb4-4829-9ea8-85daed2ea7d9)

I wondering if you would recommend using the Public=3.50.2,Private=4.0.2 configuration since that seems to consistently work? My concern would be running into other issues using different versions?

If that scenario is ok for now, all good. I do have a real show stopper in figuring out how to get the username from the login in the private Sapce? Is there a way to fetch that when I run a function in the private Space?

comments.author: reporter

Not sure how that makes sense (have done factory reboots multiple times.) So I guess we can close this one (again).

comments.author: reporter
participant1
comments.body:
Hi @reporter just a couple of quick points:

* How are you updating the versions of Gradio? You need to set the `sdk_version` in the `README.md` file (that takes precedence over the `requirements.txt` file)
* A Space running Gradio 4.x cannot `gr.load` a Space running Gradio 3.x, so please upgrade both Spaces to 4.x

Let me know if that helps
